_comment: Copy this file to config.json and edit for the printer physically attached to THIS computer. config.json is git-ignored -- each cashier machine keeps its own.

usb._comment: lsusb / Device Manager to find these. Hex strings, e.g. Epson TM-T82 is often 04b8:0202.

win32._comment: Recommended for most Windows setups -- prints through the printer's own Windows driver via the print spooler, no USB vendor/product ID lookup needed. Use GET /printers to list installed printers, or POST /config to pick one from the Settings UI's scan button.

file._comment: Writes raw ESC/POS bytes to this file instead of a real printer -- useful to inspect the exact output the 6D.1 physical-print checklist expects, with zero hardware.
